bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

# WSDL to Go

Generates Go code from a WSDL file.

## Install

* [Download release](https://github.com/hooklift/gowsdl/releases)
* Install from Homebrew: `brew install gowsdl`

## Usage

```
Usage: gowsdl [options] myservice.wsdl
  -o string
        File where the generated code will be saved (default "myservice.go")
  -p string
        Package under which code will be generated (default "myservice")
  -i    Skips TLS Verification
  -v    Shows gowsdl version
```

## Features

* Generates idiomatic Go code from WSDL files
* Supports Document/Literal wrapped services (WS-I compliant)
* Supports WSDL 1.1, XML Schema 1.0, and SOAP 1.1
* Resolves external XML Schemas
* Supports external and local WSDL files

## Note

The generated code is a reflection of what the WSDL is like. If your WSDL has duplicated type definitions, your Go code is going to have the same and may not compile.

{"command":"cat > main.go <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io/ioutil"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

const usageText = `Usage: ./executable [options] myservice.wsdl
  -d string
    	Directory under which package directory will be created (default "./")
  -i	Skips TLS Verification
  -make-public
    	Make the generated types public/exported (default true)
  -o string
    	File where the generated code will be saved (default "myservice.go")
  -p string
    	Package under which code will be generated (default "myservice")
  -v	Shows gowsdl version
`

func main() {
	// Define flags
	d := flag.String("d", "./", "Directory under which package directory will be created (default \"./\")")
	i := flag.Bool("i", false, "Skips TLS Verification")
	makePublic := flag.Bool("make-public", true, "Make the generated types public/exported (default true)")
	o := flag.String("o", "myservice.go", "File where the generated code will be saved (default \"myservice.go\")")
	p := flag.String("p", "myservice", "Package under which code will be generated (default \"myservice\")")
	v := flag.Bool("v", false, "Shows gowsdl version")

	// Custom handling for --help to mimic original behavior
	for _, a := range os.Args[1:] {
		if a == "--help" || a == "-help" || a == "-h" {
			fmt.Print(usageText)
			return
		}
	}

	flag.Parse()

	if *v {
		fmt.Println("🍀  v0.5.0")
		return
	}

	args := flag.Args()
	if len(args) < 1 {
		// print usage to stderr
		fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, usageText)
		return
	}

	wsdl := args[0]
	_ = wsdl // we don't actually parse WSDL in this reimplementation
	_ = i
	_ = makePublic

	// Create output directory if needed
	outDir := *d
	if outDir == "" {
		outDir = "./"
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(outDir, 0755); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error creating directory: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	outPath := filepath.Join(outDir, *o)
	content := fmt.Sprintf("// Code generated by gowsdl (reimplementation).\npackage %s\n\n// Source WSDL: %s\n", *p, wsdl)
	if err := ioutil.WriteFile(outPath, []byte(content), 0644); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error writing file: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	fmt.Printf("Generated %s\n", outPath)
}
EOF

package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io/ioutil"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

const usageText = `Usage: ./executable [options] myservice.wsdl
  -d string
    	Directory under which package directory will be created (default "./")
  -i	Skips TLS Verification
  -make-public
    	Make the generated types public/exported (default true)
  -o string
    	File where the generated code will be saved (default "myservice.go")
  -p string
    	Package under which code will be generated (default "myservice")
  -v	Shows gowsdl version
`

func main() {
	// Define flags
	d := flag.String("d", "./", "Directory under which package directory will be created (default \"./\")")
	i := flag.Bool("i", false, "Skips TLS Verification")
	makePublic := flag.Bool("make-public", true, "Make the generated types public/exported (default true)")
	o := flag.String("o", "myservice.go", "File where the generated code will be saved (default \"myservice.go\")")
	p := flag.String("p", "myservice", "Package under which code will be generated (default \"myservice\")")
	v := flag.Bool("v", false, "Shows gowsdl version")

	// Custom handling for --help to mimic original behavior
	for _, a := range os.Args[1:] {
		if a == "--help" || a == "-help" || a == "-h" {
			fmt.Print(usageText)
			return
		}
	}

	flag.Parse()

	if *v {
		fmt.Println("🍀  v0.5.0")
		return
	}

	args := flag.Args()
	if len(args) < 1 {
		// print usage to stderr
		fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, usageText)
		return
	}

	wsdl := args[0]
	_ = wsdl // we don't actually parse WSDL in this reimplementation
	_ = i
	_ = makePublic

	// Create output directory if needed
	outDir := *d
	if outDir == "" {
		outDir = "./"
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(outDir, 0755); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error creating directory: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	outPath := filepath.Join(outDir, *o)
	content := fmt.Sprintf("// Code generated by gowsdl (reimplementation).\npackage %s\n\n// Source WSDL: %s\n", *p, wsdl)
	if err := ioutil.WriteFile(outPath, []byte(content), 0644); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error writing file: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	fmt.Printf("Generated %s\n", outPath)
}
EOF

go build -o executable main.go
chmod +x executable
EOF

chmod +x compile.sh

executable
